observed.note: Flown by the headless pilot in test/sim/run.ts, not by a person. Re-flown for SIM_VERSION 7 (the dive payback, 2026-08-30), which every recipe recorded before it stops replaying against. The seed was chosen on coverage rather than length: of 6000 searched, only five still give the goldens everything they pin in one flight -- all four release tiers, a knock, a tight arrival, and a swing held past its own settle. 3797 is the richest of the five. Note that the pilot can now produce a tight arrival at all, which under the physics before this it could not.
